pageDescription: StarMess is an indie pixel art game about exploring a palace in space and fighting its eight bosses. In development, with local co-op in boss arenas.
heroTag: A little game in the making
heroText: A palace floating in space. A scarf that doubles as a weapon. And eight bosses who would really rather you left.
releaseNote: Still in development. No release date yet.
heroFoot: YES, THE SCARF IS A WEAPON.
aboutText: StarMess is a pixel art game about poking around a strange old palace, then getting into trouble with whatever lives there.
aboutBody: You wander through galleries, a library and a chapel, looking for a way forward. A mirror, a vase or a broken clock might lead to a boss fight. Beating the first boss brings the lights back on. It helps.
feature1Text: The rooms connect, paths loop back, and some parts of the palace are too dark to enter at first.
feature2Text: The gardener has plants. The conductor has notes. You have to work out when to duck, when to move, and when to hit back.
feature3Text: Local co-op can be unlocked for boss arenas. Exploration is solo for now. Both difficulty levels work with a controller.
galleryNote: Work in progress. Some of this will probably change.
